description: Create a customer account (POST /v1/accounts), optionally with contacts, a payment method and a first subscription. body needs name, currency and billToContact; card and bank values are redacted from every echo. Returns job_id/status queued at once; dispatch is not completion.
embedding_description: Create a Zuora customer account with its name, currency, bill-to and sold-to contacts, bill cycle day and payment terms, optionally with a credit card or other payment method and a first subscription in the same call. Card and bank details are redacted from every echo; an idempotency key makes retries safe.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job envelope. Completion carries operation, method, path, status, correlation_id and data (Zuora's response body, redacted).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Queued is not completion. On completion relay HTTP status, ids and states exactly as Zuora returned them; a write or delete may have changed vendor state, so do not replay it automatically. Credential and payment-instrument values never appear; [REDACTED] marks where Zuora echoed one.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Create a customer account (POST /v1/accounts), optionally with contacts, a payment method and a first subscription. body needs name, currency and billToContact; card and bank values are redacted from every echo.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params is input that does not match Zuora's documented shape: a bad identifier, header value or query pairing, or a body missing a required field. zuora.permission_denied is the vendor's 403 for the registered OAuth client's role, with Zuora's reason. zuora.validation_failed is a vendor 4xx or an HTTP 200 carrying success false, with Zuora's reasons. zuora.object_not_found, zuora.rate_limited and zuora.api_error map Zuora's answer; zuora.auth_failed is a 401 credential failure.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Correct the parameters, or ask the Zuora administrator to grant the OAuth client's role the needed Orders, Subscriptions or Accounts permission or enable the vendor feature the reason names. Read current vendor state with the matching get or list verb before retrying a write; pass an idempotency_key where offered. Back off on rate limits.
